recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中可見數顆雙葉核、細胞質含粗大顆粒的嗜酸性球，數量相對中性球偏多，另有一顆小淋巴球；紅血球大小不一並有橢圓形紅血球，整體提示嗜酸性球增多。
features: Several eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and cytoplasm filled with coarse granules
Eosinophils appear proportionally increased relative to neutrophils in this field
Occasional segmented neutrophil and a small lymphocyte
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including ovalocytes
Platelets present but low magnification limits granule and cytologic detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-medium power shows several eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and coarse cytoplasmic granules, together with occasional neutrophils and a small lymphocyte. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes. Detailed assessment of granulation and dysplasia is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia; an absolute eosinophil count and clinical correlation are needed to determine its cause.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have three to five nuclear lobes and fine granules rather than bilobed nuclei with coarse uniform granules.
CEL requires clonality or increased blasts, and may show dysplastic eosinophils; morphology of mature eosinophils alone cannot separate it from reactive eosinophilia.
